'''Chris Trevethan Westeville Ohio Part 2 It Got Cut Off (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Chris Trevethan]] posted on DeckTech on 2 July 2001 about [[June 2001 Westerville tournament]].<ref name="tr-d2568">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-02-westeville-ohio-part-2-it-got-cut-offd2568/ westeville-ohio-part-2-it-got-cut-off], DeckTech (chris "coolerchris2" trevethan, 2 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-02-westeville-ohio-part-2-it-got-cut-offd2568/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Chris Trevethan finished 5th at a tournament in Westerville, Ohio, going 2–2 (4 points, +27) with an EBO deck and a Dark deck; Justin Danenberg won and Brian Sykes was 2nd.
